# Vivek Narole

> Software builder who creates tools that turn expert know-how into safe, auditable automation. Background in psychology, plus three years of self-study for India's civil services exam (UPSC CSE, Psychology optional). Open to internal tools, process automation and BizOps-tech roles.

## Work
- [IT support diagnostics](https://viveknarole.com/#it-diagnostics): A ticketing system with a rule-based diagnostic engine that reads signals from a PC, finds likely root causes and runs seven low-risk fixes automatically behind safety checks and rollback. C#, .NET 8, WPF, MySQL.
- [Inventory valuation](https://viveknarole.com/#inventory-valuation): A pipeline that automates a manufacturer's inventory valuation to IAS 2 and produces an audit-ready Excel file. Python, MySQL.
